theme.title: Bubble Style & Appearance
theme.description: Choose the bubble shape that suits you — classic Telegram, smooth iOS-style, or sharp rectangles. Set message density: compact for information-rich chats or spacious for comfortable reading.

ui.title: Density & Animations
ui.description: Adjust message spacing — from compact for dense chats to spacious for comfortable reading. Control animation speed: disable entirely for max responsiveness or slow down for a smooth, polished feel.
ui.alt: Demonstration of message density and animation settings

design.title: Templates & Auto-Save
design.description: Create text templates and insert them with one tap right in the chat. Media from personal chats, groups and channels saves automatically — with flexible settings for each type.
design.alt: Demonstration of message templates and media auto-save

speed.title: Download Speed Boost
speed.description: Photos and videos load and send noticeably faster — thanks to an experimental media transfer accelerator.
speed.alt: Demonstration of settings that allow you to boost download and upload speed

camera.title: Security & Premium
camera.description: Deleted messages won't disappear — they're saved with a trash marker. Bypass restrictions in protected chats and get Telegram Premium features for free: custom emoji, real-time translation, large files and more.
camera.alt: Demonstration of security features and local Premium
